notes.title: PATCH 1.4
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE : Improvements in difficulty level and general user experience[/h1]

Many players have expressed their feelings on the difficulty of the puzzles.

Also, even though we have implemented teleportation, there were still a number of players who were having issues with motion sickness in the areas where locomotion is still required. 

 
1. Removal of locomotion in the corridor: The moment the trap is created, the player will be able to teleport through the corridor.
 
2. Modification of the “code” of the keypad puzzle: It will be a little easier to find the figure out the password. 
 
3. Modification to the Rubik’s cube puzzle: Four rotations have been changed to three.

notes.title: PATCH 1.2.01
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE: Teleportation movement option, Screen fade, Bug fix.[/h1]

1. Teleportation movement

2. Screen fade when peeking through walls

3. Bug fix: dislocation of character & camera position

As we have previously notified, we have now removed the arm swinging option in favor of a teleportation option to move around the map.

We hope that this will make a more comfortable experience.
Also, to prevent players from peeking through walls, the screen will fade to black when the camera passes through a wall.

Please continue to give us your input and feedback in order for us to make Trespass a more enjoyable experience for everyone!

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[h1]Teleportation movement option (to be updated soon)[/h1]

As the arm swinging movement option did not prove to be very effective we have decided to replace it with a teleportation option.
 
We will implement it in a way that we believe will not harm the intended gameplay experience.
However, in the section that requires physical movements, the teleportation option will not be available and movement is only possible with the trackpad button. Since this is just a short section of the game we hope that can enjoy it the way that it was intended originally.
 
Thank you for your continued interest and support!

notes.title: PATCH 1.1.10
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE: Alternative movement option[/h1]
You will now be able to move forward by swinging your arms back and forth like you would normally do when walking.

We understand that many of you would like a teleportation option but unfortunately because physical movements are a necessary part of the gameplay, a teleporting system would not be suitable. 

The arm swinging option may not be functionally perfect yet but hopefully it will help some users who are more prone to motion sickness.

We will be continuously monitoring your input in order to improve your experience of the game. 

Thank you for your interest in Trespass!
